cards.name: Ley Step
cards.headline: Move 1 space · +1 mana
cards.detail: +1 additional mana if you are at Far after moving.

cards.name: Attune
cards.headline: +1 mana · +1 card
cards.detail: +1 additional mana for each other Attune you played this turn.

cards.name: Prism
cards.headline: +2 mana · +1 card
cards.detail: Then discard 1 card.

cards.name: Arc Bolt
cards.headline: 4 damage
cards.detail: Spend 1 mana.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.headline: 8 damage
cards.detail: Spend 2 mana.

cards.name: Starfire
cards.headline: 12 damage
cards.detail: Spend 3 mana.

cards.name: Discharge
cards.headline: 2 damage per mana
cards.detail: Lose all mana.

cards.name: Cascade
cards.headline: 4 damage
cards.detail: Spend 1 mana. +2 damage for each other spell you played this turn.

cards.name: Feint
cards.headline: +1 card
cards.detail: Your Close-range attacks this turn deal +1 damage.

cards.name: Drive
cards.headline: 3 damage
cards.detail: Then move both fighters 1 space together. If a wall blocks the move, neither moves and the attack deals +2 damage.

cards.name: Opening Strike
cards.headline: 4 damage
cards.detail: If this is not your first card this turn, deal 1 damage instead.

cards.name: Rally
cards.headline: 1 damage
cards.detail: +1 damage for each other Rally you played this turn.

cards.name: Bull Rush
cards.headline: 5 damage
cards.detail: Discard 1 Melee card.

cards.name: Aim
cards.headline: +1 card
cards.detail: +2 damage to your next Ranged attack this turn.

cards.name: Repelling Shot
cards.headline: Far: 2 damage · Near: 1 damage
cards.detail: Move the opponent 1 space farther away. If they cannot move, move yourself farther away instead.

cards.name: Salvage Shot
cards.headline: Damage equal to discarded card’s cost
cards.detail: Discard 1 Ranged card. +1 card.

cards.name: Precision Shot
cards.headline: 4 damage
cards.detail: Other Precision Shots you play this turn deal 2 damage instead.

cards.name: Reclaim
cards.headline: Recover 1 card
cards.detail: Put it into your hand. If your discard pile is empty, +1 card instead.

cards.name: Regroup
cards.headline: +2 cards
cards.detail: Discard 1 card.

cards.name: Adapt
cards.headline: +1 card
cards.detail: +1 card if your position changed this turn.

cards.name: Discipline
cards.headline: 1 damage at any range
cards.detail: Trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Sharpen
cards.headline: +1 card
cards.detail: You may trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Reforge
cards.headline: Trash 1 card
cards.detail: Gain a card costing up to 3 more than it.

cards.name: Scour
cards.headline: Trash up to 2 cards
cards.detail: +1 card for each card trashed.

cards.name: Improvise
cards.headline: 2 damage per family at any range
cards.detail: Count each different Mana, Melee, or Ranged family you played this turn.

cards.name: Scrap
cards.headline: 1 damage at any range
cards.detail: Only the first Scrap you play each turn deals damage.
